_meta.why_scrub_rules_live_here: A scrub rule's MATCH SOURCE is the confidential value. Keeping the rules in the published script would re-publish every literal one directory up from the file it cleans -- and it historically forced a scan exemption for that script, blinding every gate to the one file holding every identifier. The script now carries the mechanism; this manifest carries the strings.

scrub_rules_note: Applied IN LIST ORDER to every text file under harness/ after the copy. `path` (relative to harness/) scopes a rule to one file and MUST be listed before any tree-wide rule that would otherwise mangle its match. `regex` and `ignorecase` default to false; the replacement is always literal.
